nutrition_overall.label: Overall: nutrition
nutrition_overall.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from this module's indicators; you do not measure it.
nutrition_overall.whyItMatters: It combines the module's signals into one status so no single reading raises an alert alone. Act means follow the suggested action and contact the flight surgeon.
nutrition_overall.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card. For Act, contact the flight surgeon.
